content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The FAD's conclusions (e.g., non-selection because Complainant 'did not demonstrate at the interview that he was more qualified', ratings 'justified') are stated without the underlying interview scores, rating documentation, or testimony linking evidence to the result."},"rc2":{"status":"gap","note":"Findings such as legitimate nondiscriminatory reasons and that comments 'were made to all employees' are asserted without identifying the affidavit, ROI exhibit, or witness supporting them."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Most 28 incidents carry specific dates (e.g., April 5 and May 25, 2017; January 11, 2018), but the complaint filing date, EEO contact, ROI timing, and FAD date are not given, and the background has a garbled/missing passage on timeliness and EEO activity."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record names the McDonnell Douglas framework but does not identify who decided the FAD, what was considered of Complainant's responses, or how 28 incidents were consolidated, and the FAD cites claim numbers inconsistently (e.g., B17 rating, B7 Colonel 1 comment that is actually B6)."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because reconstructability, source identification, and decision-process traceability are not met, an independent reviewer could not assess from this record alone whether the no-discrimination conclusion is supported."}}}
